CustomField.label: Slack Verification Token
CustomField.description: From Basic Information in the Slack app. Used to prove a slash command or button really came from Slack, because Apex REST empties the body of a form post and the signature has nothing left to verify against. Events arrive as JSON, keep their body, and are still checked by signature.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Slack app, Basic Information, App Credentials, Verification Token.
